title: 第4章  刚死老公就改嫁？这寡妇是吃人的！
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
日上三竿。
江翠萍像一只慵懒的小猫，蜷缩在被窝里。
锁骨白皙的肌肤印着几朵红梅。
显然是昨晚累趴带来的战绩。
虽然她年仅十八。
但根本角力不过老当益壮的李长生。
李长生穿好衣服，从床上起来，往外面走去。
“夫君，起来了吗？”
江翠萍睫毛微动。
李长生回过头，替江翠萍掖了掖被角，温声道：
“嗯。我先起出去转转，你昨晚受累了，可以接着睡一会。”
“好的，注意安全。”
原本江翠萍准备起来的，但感受到腰部传来的疼痛，以及腿软，就不再勉强了。夫君怎么那么强啊？我根本顶不住。
李长生挥了挥手，走出房门，深吸了一口深秋凛冽的空气。
院子里老魁树上有两只乌鸦在叫。
虽然有点晦气。
但李长生心情不错。
昨晚连续突破两境，已经炼气五层了。
虽然看起来不高，但是在安置区，已经算是高手了。
王麻子也只不过是炼气二层罢了。

李长生走在路上，摸了摸袖口。
被遣散时。
宗门发了十枚下品灵石作为安家费。
昨天修炼已经花去了一枚。
剩下九枚。
若是坐吃山空，坚持不了两个月。
凡人吃五谷杂粮，生老病死；
修仙者若断了灵气补给，修为倒退不说，寿元也会受损。
“所以……”
“得搞钱啊！”
李长生喃喃一声。
来坊市逛了一圈。
买了一套画符箓装备之后。
就返回自己房子的地下室，开始练习画符。
画符师是一个很需要资质的职业。
有天赋可事半功倍。
没天赋的话，连符文都看不懂。
李长生以前在宗门，接触过符箓，但资质不行，连最基础的【照明符】都画不出来。
但是现在不一样了。
他融合了系统奖励的【灵符真解】。

原本理解不了的符文原理，现在统统搞懂了。
“所以……”
“李长生想试试看。”
“看看能不能通过画符赚钱。”
李长生不是犹豫的人，说干就干。
先是研磨朱砂。
然后混入低阶妖兽的血液。
体内灵力顺着手臂涌入笔尖。
开始画符文。
令其震惊的是，自己竟然没有任何生疏的感觉。
抓着的符笔。
就像是手臂的延伸。
刷刷刷！
笔走龙蛇。
一气呵成。
随着最后一笔勾勒完成，符纸上的纹路形成一个循环，亮起红色的微光。
【一阶灵符：火球符】
李长生心头狂喜。
系统奖励的东西果然给力。
竟然一次就画成功了。

而且根据灵力波动来看，这一阶灵符，可比市面上的灵符要稳定不少。
如果每次画符都成功的话。
画符赚钱的路子就行得通了。
李长生喃喃一声，随后趁热打铁，又拿起一张符纸，开始画了起来。
他这次画的是火球术。
同样一次成功。
连续两次的成功。
让其信心大增。
李长生开始画更复杂的【金刚符】、【神行符】。
连续画了二十张，统统都成功了。
灵符分别是：
五张【火球符】。
五张【金刚符】。
五张【神行符】。
五张【隐匿符】。
虽然都是一阶的，但李长生仿佛看到了一堆灵石向自己招手。
在坊市，一张一阶下品符箓，能卖两块下品灵石。
二十张灵符就是四十块灵石。
成本只不过是两块金币罢了。
妥妥暴利啊！

李长生兴奋过后，逐渐冷静下来。
将这些符箓收好。
他没有立刻拿出去卖。
刚被遣散的老头，突然拿出一堆品质不错的灵符，很容易被人盯上。
得想一个更稳健的办法出手才行。
当天下午，王麻子又来了，依旧炫耀自己的老婆。
真是狗改不了吃屎。
李长生一脸羡慕听着，时不时竖起大拇指，夸赞道：“老王，你真老当益壮，我辈楷模啊！不像我，娶了个凡人妻，除了做饭啥也不会。”
王麻子听了，心里舒坦，更是迷上找李长生炫耀自己的婆娘了。
每隔几天就来一次。
不厌其烦。
李长生却烦了。
如果不是看在王麻子，即将命不久矣，都想直接刀了对方了。
一直在我面前装逼。
有意思吗？
这种情况一直持续到半个月后的某个深夜。
李长生正跟江翠萍夜夜笙歌，忽然耳边传来一阵凄厉的惨叫。
“啊！”
“救……”
李长生闻言，猛地睁开眼。

这声音？
这不是王麻子的声音吗？
王麻子的老婆对王麻子下手了吗？
王麻子的婆娘叫做赵燕。
江翠萍闻言，也是被吓得一哆嗦，下意识钻进李长生怀里：
“夫君，怎么了？”
李长生拍了拍江翠萍的后背，安慰道：
“没事，睡吧！”
“咱们不管别人的事情。”
虽然他很想出去看一眼，但是还是忍住了。
外面可是事发现场。
不管如何。
只要出现在事发现场。
就有几率惹上麻烦。
君子不立于危墙之下。
能不招惹麻烦。
就不招惹麻烦。
李长生是绝对不会因为好奇，而出去看看的。
看来只能第二天睡醒之后，再向周围的同道，打听一下，是怎么回事了。
第二天。

天蒙蒙亮。
外面的巷道便热闹了起来。
“你听说了吗？昨晚王老头死了。”
“出啥事了？”
“怎么死的？”
“不知道。”
“我只看到王麻子，浑身精血都被吸光了。最后只剩下皮包骨头。然后被人抬走。”
“咱们不是在青云宗脚下吗？出了那么大事，青云宗不管么？”
“青云宗那么高傲，才死了几位被优化弟子，怎么可能会管？”
李长生在屋内，听着众人的谈话。
正准备起来。
耳边又传来了一阵假慈悲的哭声。
“呜呜呜，夫君你怎么就走了啊？”
“你死得好惨啊！”
“你走了，我该怎么办啊？”
这哭哭啼啼的，便是王麻子的婆娘赵燕。
赵燕穿着一套华贵的锦衣，哭得梨花带雨，楚楚可怜。
周围的老头们看这架势，面面相觑，目露同情。
“哎。”
“老王没福气，这么漂亮的婆娘，都无福消受。”

“这婆娘也是可怜，刚嫁过来就守了寡。”
“要不我领回去算了。”
众人七嘴八舌，有的惋惜，有的幸灾乐祸。
更多的是色眯眯地盯着赵燕诱惑的身体。
唯独李长生，躲在房子里面，心中冷笑。
假慈悲什么呢？
李长生早就闻到赵燕身上的血腥味了。
恐怕王麻子就是被你害死的吧！
还吸光了王麻子的精血。
令其死后肉身都不得完整。
真是残忍。
李长生已经确定了，赵燕就是修炼采补之术的邪修。
至于是哪一个派别的？
就判断不出来了。
线索实在太少了。
李长生心念间，灵识忽然感应到，外面的赵燕抬起头，眼睛向自己方向。
那是一双怎样的眼睛啊。
媚意横生。
又透着毒蛇般阴冷的寒意。
两人灵识在空中一触即分。

李长生收回灵识，心头一跳。
好厉害的邪修。
感知能力太变态了！
我就看了一眼。
怎么就发现我了呢？
希望别找我麻烦。
与此同时。
赵燕也不动声色地收回目光。
真奇怪！
李老头的气血怎么那么雄厚呢？
甚至比炼气四层的修士还浑厚。
之前怎么没有发现呢？
难道扮猪吃老虎？
不管怎么说，李老头气血浑厚，都符合猎物标准了。
决定了。
将李老头放入我猎物清单里面。
老王啊！
你不会死得很寂寞。
我很快就将你的朋友送下去陪你。
这时刚刚说领赵燕回去那位老头，见赵燕没有说话，连忙又重复了一句：

“赵燕小美人。”
“你愿意跟我走么？”
“我包会照顾好你的。”
这位老头叫做谢明。
练气三层。
修为比王麻子高一层。
赵燕闻言，犹豫了一会，抬起头，看了谢明两眼，点点头。
“好啊！”
在众目睽睽之下。
不好对李长生下手。
得徐徐图之。
既然谢明都送上门了。
那就先吸光他再说。
李长生听到赵燕跟着谢明离开，这才暗自松了一口气。
果然女人就是灾祸。
任何跟女人相关的东西都是麻烦。
还是我老婆好。
不但忠贞不渝。
而且旺夫。
虽然赵燕跟谢明离开了，李长生依旧保持警惕。

万一呢？
即便几率再小。
也是有危险的。
君子不立于危墙之下。
既然这份因果已经找上门了。
那么最好的办法就是将赵燕杀了。
彻底了却这一段因果。
麻烦啊！
关键是赵燕被谢明带走了，也不好杀啊！
李长生喃喃一声。
这时站在李长生旁边的江翠萍，抬起头，看着自己的夫君，有些紧张地开口：
“夫君，隔壁王大哥他……”
李长生语气平静：“死了。”
“以后离赵燕那个女人远点。”
“那个女人很危险。”
“如若是她来找你借东西，或者说话，一概不要理会，锁好门就可以了。”
“啊？哦……好的。”
虽然江翠萍不懂，但看到夫君严肃的样子，也知道事情严重，连忙点头。
“睡吧。”
李长生吹灭了灯，一整晚都没有睡。

content_en:
Three poles in the sun.
Jiang Cuiping was like a lazy kitten, curled up in the bed.
There are a few red plum blossoms printed on the white skin of the collarbone.
It was obviously a result of the exhausting party last night.
Although she is only eighteen years old.
But he couldn't compete with the ever-strong Li Changsheng.
Li Changsheng got dressed, got up from the bed, and walked outside.
"Husband, are you up?"
Jiang Cuiping's eyelashes twitched slightly.
Li Changsheng turned around, tucked Jiang Cuiping into bed, and said warmly:
"Yeah. I'll get up and go out for a walk first. You were tired last night, so you can go on to sleep for a while."
"Okay, stay safe."
Jiang Cuiping was originally ready to get up, but when she felt the pain coming from her waist and the weakness in her legs, she stopped trying. Why is your husband so strong? I can't stand it at all.
Li Changsheng waved his hand, walked out of the room, and took a deep breath of the crisp late autumn air.
There were two crows cawing on the old Kui tree in the yard.
Although a bit unlucky.
But Li Changsheng was in a good mood.
Last night, I broke through two realms in a row and reached the fifth level of Qi refining.
Although it doesn't look high, he is already considered a master in the resettlement area.
Wang Mazi is only at the second level of Qi refining.
Li Changsheng walked on the road and touched his sleeves.
When being dismissed.
The sect distributed ten low-grade spiritual stones as settlement expenses.
I spent one on my practice yesterday.
There are nine left.
If you sit back and have nothing, you won't be able to last two months.
Mortals eat whole grains and grains, and are born, old, sick and die;
If a cultivator loses his spiritual energy supply, his cultivation will regress, and his longevity will also be damaged.
"So..."
"We have to make money!"
Li Changsheng murmured.
I took a walk around Laifang City.
After buying a set of talisman painting equipment.
He returned to the basement of his house and started practicing drawing talismans.
Talisman painter is a profession that requires a lot of qualifications.
Having talent can get twice the result with half the effort.
If you don't have talent, you won't even be able to understand the runes.
Li Changsheng had been exposed to talismans in the sect before, but his qualifications were not good and he couldn't even draw the most basic [Lighting Talisman].
But it's different now.
He incorporates the [True Solution to Spirit Talisman] rewarded by the system.
The principles of runes that were previously incomprehensible are now understood.
"So..."
"Li Changsheng wants to give it a try."
"Let's see if we can make money by drawing symbols."
Li Changsheng is not a hesitant person, he just does what he says.
First, grind the cinnabar.
Then mixed with the blood of low-level monsters.
The spiritual energy in his body poured into the pen tip along his arm.
Start drawing runes.
What shocked him was that he didn't feel any strangeness at all.
The holding pen.
It's like an extension of your arm.
Swish, brush, brush!
The pen moves the dragon and the snake.
Done in one go.
As the final outline was completed, the lines on the talisman paper formed a loop and shimmered with red light.
[First level talisman: Fireball talisman]
Li Changsheng was ecstatic.
The system rewards are really impressive.
I actually succeeded in painting it in one try.
And judging from the fluctuations in spiritual power, this level of spiritual talisman is much more stable than the spiritual talismans on the market.
If every draw is successful.
The way to make money by drawing talismans is feasible.
Li Changsheng murmured, then struck while the iron was hot, picked up another piece of talisman paper, and began to draw.
What he drew this time was the fireball technique.
Same success.
Two consecutive successes.
Boost their confidence.
Li Changsheng began to draw more complex [Diamond Talisman] and [Magic Talisman].
I drew twenty pictures in a row and all of them were successful.
The talismans are:
Five [Fireball Talisman].
Five [Diamond Talismans].
Five [Magic Talisman].
Five [Concealment Talisman].
Although they were all of the first level, Li Changsheng seemed to see a bunch of spiritual stones waving to him.
In the market, a first-level low-grade talisman can be sold for two low-grade spiritual stones.
Twenty spiritual talismans are forty spiritual stones.
The cost is just two gold coins.
What a huge profit!
After Li Changsheng became excited, he gradually calmed down.
Collect these talismansgood.
He didn't sell it immediately.
The old man who had just been dismissed suddenly took out a bunch of good-quality talismans, and it was easy for him to be targeted.
We have to think of a more stable way to take action.
That afternoon, Wang Mazi came again, still showing off his wife.
It’s true that a dog can’t change its habit of eating shit.
Li Changsheng listened with envy on his face, giving thumbs up from time to time and praising: "Old Wang, you are so old and strong, you are a role model for our generation! Unlike me, I married a mortal wife and can do nothing but cook."
Wang Mazi felt relieved after hearing this, and even more obsessed with showing off his wife to Li Changsheng.
Come every few days.
Take the trouble.
Li Changsheng was annoyed.
If it weren't for Wang Mazi, who was about to die soon, he would have wanted to kill him directly.
Always showing off in front of me.
Interesting?
This situation lasted until late one night half a month later.
Li Changsheng was singing night after night with Jiang Cuiping, when suddenly a shrill scream came from his ears.
"Ah!"
"Save..."
When Li Changsheng heard this, he opened his eyes suddenly.
This sound?
Isn't this Wang Mazi's voice?
Did Wang Mazi's wife take action against Wang Mazi?
Wang Mazi's mother-in-law is called Zhao Yan.
Jiang Cuiping was frightened when she heard this, and subconsciously got into Li Changsheng's arms:
"Husband, what's wrong?"
Li Changsheng patted Jiang Cuiping's back and comforted:
"It's okay, go to sleep!"
"We don't care about other people's affairs."
Although he wanted to take a look, he resisted.
The incident happened outside.
No matter what.
Just show up at the scene of the incident.
There is a chance of getting into trouble.
A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall.
Can avoid getting into trouble.
Don't cause trouble.
Li Changsheng would never go out to take a look out of curiosity.
It seemed that I could only wake up the next day and ask the comrades around me what was going on.
the next day.
The sky is bright.
The alley outside became lively.
"Have you heard? Old man Wang died last night."
"What happened?"
"How did you die?"
"I don't know."
"I only saw Wang Mazi. All the blood and essence had been sucked out of his body. In the end, only skin and bones were left. Then he was carried away."
"Aren't we at the feet of the Qingyun Sect? If such a big thing happens, will the Qingyun Sect not care?"
"The Qingyun Sect is so arrogant, and only a few of its optimized disciples died. How could they care?"
Li Changsheng was in the room, listening to everyone's conversation.
Getting ready.
Another cry of false compassion came to my ears.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu Husband, why did you just leave?"
"You died so miserably!"
"You're gone, what should I do?"
This crying person is Wang Mazi's mother-in-law, Zhao Yan.
Zhao Yan wore a set of luxurious brocade clothes and cried so hard that she looked pitiful.
Seeing this posture, the old men around him looked at each other with sympathy.
"Hey."
"Old Wang is not blessed, and such a beautiful woman cannot be blessed."
"This woman is also pitiful. She became a widow just after she got married."
"How about I take it back and forget it."
Everyone was talking about it, some were sorry, some were gloating about the misfortune.
Most of them were staring at Zhao Yan's tempting body with lustful eyes.
Only Li Changsheng was hiding in the house, sneering in his heart.
What is false compassion?
Li Changsheng had already smelled the blood on Zhao Yan's body.
I'm afraid Wang Mazi was killed by you!
It also sucked up all of Wang Mazi’s blood essence.
His body will not be intact after death.
How cruel.
Li Changsheng has determined that Zhao Yan is an evil cultivator who practices the art of tonic.
As for which faction?
I can't tell.
There are so few clues.
While Li Changsheng was thinking, his spiritual sense suddenly sensed that Zhao Yan outside raised his head and turned his eyes in his direction.
What a pair of eyes those are.
Full of charm.
There was also a chill as cold as a poisonous snake.
two peopleSpiritual consciousness is divided in the air as soon as it is touched.
Li Changsheng withdrew his spiritual consciousness and his heart skipped a beat.
What a powerful evil cultivator.
Perception is so perverted!
I just took a look.
How did you find me?
I hope you won't cause trouble for me.
at the same time.
Zhao Yan also calmly withdrew her gaze.
How strange!
Why is Old Man Li's blood so strong?
Even thicker than the monks at the fourth level of Qi Refining.
Why haven't you discovered it before?
Are you pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger?
In any case, Old Man Li has strong energy and blood, and he meets the standards of prey.
It’s decided.
Put Old Man Li on my prey list.
Lao Wang!
You won't die alone.
I'll send your friend down to stay with you soon.
At this time, the old man who had just said to take Zhao Yan back saw that Zhao Yan did not speak, so he quickly repeated:
"Little beauty Zhao Yan."
"Will you come with me?"
"I'll take good care of you."
This old man's name is Xie Ming.
Three levels of Qi training.
His cultivation is one level higher than Wang Mazi.
Zhao Yan heard this, hesitated for a while, raised her head, glanced at Xie Ming, and nodded.
"Okay!"
In full view.
It's not good to attack Li Changsheng.
You have to figure it out slowly.
Now that Xie Ming has arrived.
Then suck him up first and then talk.
Li Changsheng secretly breathed a sigh of relief when he heard that Zhao Yan left with Xie Ming.
Sure enough, women are a disaster.
Anything related to women is trouble.
My wife is better.
Not only loyal.
And Wangfu.
Although Zhao Yan and Xie Ming left, Li Changsheng remained vigilant.
What if?
No matter how small the chance is.
There are dangers too.
A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall.
Now that the cause and effect has come to your door.
Then the best way is to kill Zhao Yan.
Completely resolve this cause and effect.
Trouble!
The key is that Zhao Yan was taken away by Xie Ming, so it’s not easy to kill him!
Li Changsheng murmured.
At this time, Jiang Cuiping, who was standing next to Li Changsheng, raised her head, looked at her husband, and spoke nervously:
"Husband, Brother Wang next door..."
Li Changsheng said calmly: "Dead."
"Stay away from that woman Zhao Yan from now on."
"That woman is dangerous."
"If she comes to borrow something from you or talks to you, just ignore her and just lock the door."
"Huh? Oh...Okay."
Although Jiang Cuiping didn't understand, she saw her husband's serious look and knew that the matter was serious, so she nodded quickly.
"Go to sleep."
Li Changsheng blew out the lamp and didn't sleep all night.
How can you allow others to care about you on the side of your bed? ? ?
